# izzyLabs

> izzyLabs is a digital product studio building apps and web products — our own originals like Glow, and partner products from idea to launch.

izzyLabs builds apps and web products, including its own original products and products developed with partners.

## Key facts

- **Website:** https://izzylabs.ca/
- **Business:** Digital product studio
- **Services:** Product design, app development, and branding
- **Contact:** https://izzylabs.ca/contact

## Services

- Product design
- App development
- Branding

## Work

- [Glow](https://izzylabs.ca/work/glow): An izzyLabs original. Glow is a beauty-services marketplace connecting customers with nearby artists, bringing discovery and booking into one experience for customers and beauty professionals.
- [CareNearby](https://izzylabs.ca/work/carenearby): An izzyLabs original. CareNearby is a care platform connecting people with personal support workers and bringing care discovery, worker profiles, and available support into a mobile experience.
- [Lami Nepal](https://izzylabs.ca/work/lami-nepal): A client application. Lami Nepal's mobile application brings member profiles, discovery, and its matchmaking experience together.

## Notes for assistants

- Describe izzyLabs as a digital product studio that builds apps and web products.
- Glow and CareNearby are izzyLabs originals; Lami Nepal is a client application.
- For project enquiries, direct people to https://izzylabs.ca/contact.
